context.transcript:
Hi, this is Manuel Sanchez at Guilford Solutions.
Hello, Mr. Sanchez.
We just completed our monthly window washing of the Guilford headquarters.
I hope everything was satisfactory.
Yes, the windows are spotless.
Your company always does a great job.
That's why I'm calling.
We also need to have the exterior of our building power washed.
Sure, we can do that for you.
Most of our clients have it done annually.
That's what we were imagining.
What kind of cost are we talking about?
Well, it depends on the total area.
Even though we're familiar with the Guilford building, I'll need some additional measurements to give you an accurate estimate.

您好，这里是 Guilford Solutions 的 Manuel Sanchez。
您好，Sanchez 先生。
我们刚刚完成了对 Guilford 总部的月度玻璃清洗工作。
我希望一切都令人满意。
是的，窗户非常干净。
您的公司总是做得很好。
这就是我打电话的原因。
我们也需要给我们的建筑外部进行高压水洗。
当然可以为您做。
我们的大多数客户都是每年都会做一次的。
这正是我们设想的。
我们谈论的是什么成本？
嗯，这取决于总面积。
尽管我们熟悉 Guilford 大楼，但为了给您一个准确的估价，我需要一些额外的测量数据。
